## Tutorial 1

```{ojs}
// L is a reactive variable that loads the Leaflet.js library and its CSS if not already present
L = {
  const L = await require("leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js");
  if (!document.getElementById('leaflet-css-fix')) {
    const link = document.createElement('link');
    link.id = 'leaflet-css-fix';
    link.rel = 'stylesheet';
    link.href = "https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css";
    document.head.appendChild(link);
  }
  return L;
}

// mapContainer is a reactive variable
mapContainer = {

    // Create a container for the map, style it, and yield it to be used by Leaflet
    const container = document.createElement("div");
    container.style.height = "480px";
    container.style.width = "640px";    
    container.style.margin = "0 auto";
    yield container;

    // Initialize the Leaflet map in the container and set its view to a specific location and zoom level
    const map = L.map(container).setView([51.505, -0.09], 13);

    // Add a tile layer to the map using OpenStreetMap tiles, with attribution and maximum zoom level
    L.tileLayer('https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
        maxZoom: 19,
        attribution: '&copy; <a href="http://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>'
    }).addTo(map);

    // Add a marker, a circle and a polygon
    var marker = L.marker([51.5, -0.09]).addTo(map);
    var circle = L.circle([51.508, -0.11], {
        color: 'red',
        fillColor: '#f03',
        fillOpacity: 0.5,
        radius: 500
    }).addTo(map);
    var polygon = L.polygon([
        [51.509, -0.08],
        [51.503, -0.06],
        [51.51, -0.047]
    ]).addTo(map);

    // Add popups to the marker, circle and polygon
    marker.bindPopup("<b>Hello world!</b><br>I am a popup.").openPopup();
    circle.bindPopup("I am a circle.");
    polygon.bindPopup("I am a polygon.");  

    // Add a standalone popup at a specific location on the map
    var popup = L.popup()
        .setLatLng([51.513, -0.09])
        .setContent("I am a standalone popup.")
        .openOn(map);

    // Add an event listener to the map that shows a popup with the coordinates of the clicked location
    var popup = L.popup();
    function onMapClick(e) {
        popup
            .setLatLng(e.latlng)
            .setContent("You clicked the map at " + e.latlng.toString())
            .openOn(map);
    }
    map.on('click', onMapClick);
}
```
